turns.user: Check all fridges. For any with temperature (temp_c) violating the cold-chain limit (>=4°C), send it a set_alarm command to turn the alarm on, and create an alert rule named retail-fridge-3-coldchain-alert.

per_turn: Turn 1: device control fridge-3 set_alarm + rule create retail-fridge-3-coldchain-alert
expectations.overall: set_alarm sent to fridge-3 + alert rule created - both land
